title: architecture-tradeoff-analysis-skill Input
description: Input contract for formal architectural trade-off analysis

decision_question.description: The decision framed as a question: 'Should we use X or Y for [context]?' This prevents premature closure.

alternatives.description: Viable options to compare. Must include Golden Path default if applicable.

evaluation_criteria.description: Criteria to evaluate each alternative against. If omitted, the skill derives criteria from the decision context.

architecture_path.description: Path to Architecture.md or Architecture_Decisions.md to append the trade-off analysis to.

triggering_context.description: What triggered this analysis. Affects the level of detail required.

prd_requirement_id.description: Optional PRD requirement ID that this decision serves.
